verdict.rationale: Teller is a bank-data API, and a financial data platform could plausibly offer AI-generated insights, so the axis applies. The evidence only documents raw data endpoints for balances, transactions and identity, plus transaction categorization. That categorization is an adjacent data field, not AI-generated insights or suggestions delivered inside the product. Nothing in the pack shows any AI insight capability.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product
